coverageNotes: Tests the query-builder versus array-filter boundary. Sorting and predicate business rules are supplied, and full-table scans are not falsely labelled incorrect.

questions.concept: Materialize a query before JavaScript filtering
questions.question: Which block completes the handler?

options.rationale: collect materializes every matching document; the subsequent Array.filter runs ordinary JavaScript predicates.

options.text:
```ts
const selected = await authorQuery
  .filter((msg) => msg.isPinned && msg.likes >= args.minLikes)
  .collect();
```
options.rationale: A Convex query-builder filter callback receives a FilterBuilder, not a document. Direct msg.isPinned/msg.likes property access is statically invalid; when typechecking is bypassed, an empty range returns [], but a nonempty range rejects the undefined predicate result.
take(10) can omit later qualifying messages before the JavaScript predicate runs.

options.text:
```ts
const selected = await authorQuery
  .filter((q) => q.and(q.eq(q.field("isPinned"), true), q.gte(q.field("likes"), args.minLikes)))
  .collect();
```
options.rationale: This native database filter returns the correct values in the fixtures but does not load all author messages before evaluating the two checks in JavaScript.
